europe_now.title: Diplomatic Tensions Following Diplomatic Expulsions and Sanctions
europe_now.summary: Hungary has expelled ten Russian diplomats amid growing espionage concerns and deteriorating diplomatic ties. Concurrently, European nations implementing trade sanctions on Israeli settlements have triggered retaliatory diplomatic measures in the Middle East.

europe_now.title: Critical Infrastructure and Security Incidents Across Europe
europe_now.summary: German police have successfully arrested a suspected saboteur following an extensive manhunt prompted by a series of attacks on the national power grid. Meanwhile, ongoing conflict in Ukraine continues to cause civilian casualties and structural damage from drone strikes.

sources.headline: German police arrest suspected power grid saboteur after manhunt

top_stories.title: Cultural Heritage Thefts and Institution Controversies
top_stories.summary: French authorities are currently searching for thieves responsible for a rapid museum art heist involving Renoir works. In related domestic news, the Eiffel Tower reopened to the public following a staff dispute concerning workplace rules.

top_stories.title: Political Debates and Legal Proceedings
